key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8DDA
name: repeat_calls_then_restore_global
description: Saves a 32-bit shared global, calls a routine four times (the routine calls itself recursively) when a control word is nonzero, then restores the saved global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8E56
name: load_three_table_entries
description: Loads three 32-bit entries from a pointer table into a shared global and calls the routine after each load, passing unchanged registers on.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8EE4
name: dispatch_handler_for_free_slot
description: Clears a per-object flag and sets a shared flag, then scans a two-entry table of 24-word slots for an empty one and jumps through a handler pointer table indexed by a stored type value when a distance and state check pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8F3E
name: spawn_object_record_type_two
description: Decrements a remaining-count word and, if it was nonzero, fills the next object record with current position, angle, scaled size and a fixed type code, sets the active-record pointer and calls the update routine four times.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8F66
name: spawn_object_record_type_three
description: Decrements a remaining-count word and, if it was nonzero, fills an object record with current position, angle, a stored parameter and a fixed type code, then calls the update routine four times and resets a timer when the count is still positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8F94
name: spawn_object_record_type_one
description: Decrements a remaining-count word and, if it was nonzero, fills an object record with current position, angle and a fixed type code, then calls the update routine four times and resets a timer when the count is still positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:8FF2
name: copy_source_record_into_object
description: Copies the fields of a source record (position, angle, size, a pointer and a flag word) into the object record, applies a fixed vertical offset, sets the active-record pointer and calls the update routine four times.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9086
name: toggle_flag_and_mark_state
description: Clears a per-object flag, sets a shared marker byte to all ones, toggles a state word, and sets a second marker to one when the toggled word returns to zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:90A4
name: toggle_state_when_position_changes
description: Clears a per-object flag; if the tracked position differs from the stored one, it toggles a state word and sets a marker, unless that state is already set and a distance value exceeds a limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:90CA
name: toggle_secondary_state_flag
description: Flips a state word between zero and one and sets a shared marker byte to all ones.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:90DA
name: invert_alternating_toggle_word
description: Bit-inverts a shared toggle word and clears a per-object flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:90E6
name: update_four_digit_countdown
description: Decrements a four-character ASCII counter digit by digit, wrapping each digit from below zero to nine, and resets it to four zeros at the floor. When a flag is set and the stored position moved by at least eight units, it claims a free object slot and fills it with positions scaled from a lookup table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:929A
name: find_nearest_target_record
description: Scans two object tables with different record sizes, skipping the current target and records marked inactive, and returns the candidate with the smallest horizontal offset within a range limit, updating the stored target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:92AC
name: copy_uppercase_text_to_buffer
description: Clears a 48-byte text buffer to spaces, copies a null-terminated string into it converting lowercase letters to uppercase and stopping at the buffer end, then calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:92CA
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:92EC
name: show_uppercase_stores_exhausted_message
description: Copies the stores-exhausted text into a 48-byte text buffer as uppercase characters, then calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:92F8
name: release_flare_and_message
description: When a flare count is nonzero, decrements it, marks the active flare with a shared flag and stores the current position and a computed offset; then copies the flare-released text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9346
name: release_chaff_and_message
description: When a chaff count is nonzero, decrements it, marks the active chaff with a shared flag and stores the current position and a computed offset; then copies the chaff-released text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9394
name: cycle_detail_level_text
description: Decrements a one-digit ASCII detail-level setting, wrapping it below zero back to two and resetting a companion counter, then copies the detail-level text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9406
name: cycle_engine_sound_state
description: Advances a 16-bit sound-state counter in a shared record; at five it calls a handler and resets the flags, at two, three or four it sets the matching sound flags and calls handlers from the global pointer table, otherwise it calls a default handler, then copies the engine-sound-off text into the message buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:944E
name: enable_sound_effects_state
description: Calls a sound-control handler from the global handler table, clears a per-object counter and sets the sound flags to effects-on, then copies the sound-effects-on text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:947C
name: silence_all_sound_output
description: Sets a sound-off flag, calls the sound-control handler from the global handler table, then copies the all-sound-off text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9492
name: select_music_track_one
description: Sets one music flag and clears two others, calls the sound-control handler, then copies the Music 1 text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:94B4
name: select_music_track_two
description: Sets one music flag and clears two others, calls the sound-control handler, then copies the Music 2 text into the message buffer and calls the display routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9518
name: call_stored_handler_pointer
description: Calls a handler through a function pointer stored in a shared record and returns the saved register values unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:952A
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper routine and returns, passing through the register values it receives.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:953C
name: swap_word_and_call_handler
description: Saves a 32-bit word in the record, replaces it with the word that follows, calls a handler through the record's pointer table and restores the saved word, setting two shared marker bytes when a status byte indicates a pending state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:959A
name: clear_flag_and_call_handler
description: Clears a per-object flag and calls a handler through the record's pointer table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:95A4
name: cycle_control_sensitivity_text
description: Advances a two-bit control sensitivity counter from one to three, wrapping back to one, stores the new value as a digit character, and copies the control-sensitivity text into the message buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:95F0
name: cycle_index_and_store_value
description: Advances a two-bit index modulo four, copies the longword selected by that index from the object record into the location held by a stored pointer, then runs the shared message-formatting routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:95F2
name: cycle_control_method_setting
description: Advances a two-bit index modulo four, copies the longword selected by that index into the location held by a stored pointer, then copies the control-method text into the message buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9686
name: or_angle_masks_into_bitplane
description: Converts a scaled 0-to-360 angle into a sector index and an offset, selects one of eight stored mask blocks, and ORs their 16-bit masks into the bitplane buffer at rows set by the angle.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:96BA
name: or_pattern_masks_while_counting
description: While a countdown word is positive, decrements it and ORs cached 16-bit mask values into bitplane rows at positions 40 bytes apart, using a shared pattern word for the first row.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:96F0
name: or_pattern_masks_into_rows
description: Calls six helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive decrements it and ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed 40-byte spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9798
name: or_countdown_masks_into_bitplane
description: Calls helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive decrements it and ORs cached pattern masks from two table sets into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9834
name: or_masks_after_target_check
description: Checks a target-validity word and an alternate pointer, calls helper routines on the valid branch, then ORs cached countdown pattern masks into bitplane rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9862
name: or_masks_for_second_target
description: Calls helper routines according to a target-sign word, then while a countdown word is positive ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:999E
name: load_target_and_or_masks
description: Copies three shared values from a target record, or from a stored alternate pointer when the target is invalid, then calls helper routines and ORs cached countdown pattern masks into bitplane rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:99F0
name: store_target_and_or_masks
description: Stores three shared values derived from a target pointer, calls helper routines, then ORs cached countdown pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9B3E
name: or_masks_after_helper_calls
description: Calls five helper routines and then runs the countdown-gated pattern-mask OR into bitplane rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9B6E
name: or_masks_after_four_calls
description: Calls four helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive decrements it and ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9B72
name: or_masks_tail_entry_one
description: Enters the shared countdown-gated pattern-mask OR body directly, ORing cached masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing while a countdown word is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9B76
name: or_masks_after_five_calls
description: Calls five helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive decrements it and ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9BB2
name: start_blitter_copy_operation
description: Waits while the blitter busy flag is set, then writes blitter control, modulo and pointer registers from stored addresses and starts the operation.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9C60
name: or_masks_after_four_calls
description: Calls four helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive decrements it and ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9C9C
name: or_masks_after_pointer_check
description: Branches on a stored pointer's contents, calls helper routines on each branch, then ORs cached countdown pattern masks into bitplane rows while a countdown word is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9D52
name: or_masks_after_five_helpers
description: Calls five helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows at fixed spacing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9D9C
name: advance_timed_title_sequence
description: Counts down a timer word and, when it reaches zero, runs a state step: when a sequence flag is clear it resets the timer and writes marker bytes; the F15 Strike Eagle title text is referenced.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9DF2
name: copy_selected_table_block
description: Looks up a 50-byte table entry from an index returned by a helper; an empty entry disables the timer, otherwise it sets a 64-count timer and copies a block of bytes from the entry into a fixed destination.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9E3A
name: select_flagged_entry_and_copy
description: Searches 86-byte table entries for one with a flag bit set, sets a 32-count timer and the entry pointer, then copies a zero-terminated byte string from a shared buffer into the code slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9E42
name: select_patrol_entry_and_copy
description: Searches 86-byte table entries for one with a flag bit set, sets a 32-count timer, then copies a zero-terminated string including the on-patrol text into a fixed destination.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9EB4
name: enable_dma_channels_and_init
description: Clears a timer, writes marker bytes into shared state, and writes the DMA control register with the enable bit set, then calls setup helpers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:9F5A
name: update_state_then_or_masks
description: Updates a shared state word and calls helper routines depending on a sign test, then ORs cached countdown pattern masks into bitplane rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A04E
name: or_masks_when_timer_active
description: Calls helper routines and copies several shared words, then while a countdown word is positive ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows when the timer word is active.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A100
name: or_masks_after_timer_branch
description: Calls helper routines and copies shared words, then while a countdown word is positive ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows, branching on the timer word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_position_and_or_masks
description: Copies three shared position words, calls helper routines, then while a countdown word is positive ORs cached pattern masks into bitplane rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_position_then_or_masks
description: Copies three shared position words, calls helper routines, then ORs cached countdown pattern masks into bitplane rows when a countdown word is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A2B6
name: setup_sprite_pointers_and_data
description: Computes a sprite data address from a position in five-unit steps, writes it and a control word into the sprite pointer registers, and saves the previous values for later restoration.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A3A2
name: setup_sprite_from_digit_index
description: Computes a sprite data address from a value divided and taken modulo ten, writes the address and a control word to a sprite pointer register and saves the previous values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_two_pointer_targets
description: Writes zero to two longwords reached through pointers stored in the record, then returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_pointer_words_if_flagged
description: When a flag is set, copies two 32-bit values from the source record into two fields of the object record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A492
name: store_word_after_helper_calls
description: Calls two helper routines and stores the incoming word into a shared variable.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A4CA
name: copy_sprite_setup_longwords
description: Copies six 32-bit values from a table record into shared locations used for the sprite pointer setup, then returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A50C
name: copy_five_sprite_setup_values
description: Copies five 32-bit values from a table record into shared locations used for the sprite pointer setup, then returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A54E
name: position_sprite_by_column
description: When a timer word is zero, computes a sprite position from a value divided by five with a half-step adjustment, then writes the sprite data address and control word into the sprite pointer slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A55A
name: copy_sprite_value_repeatedly
description: Repeatedly copies one 32-bit value from the record into shared locations and returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A58C
name: copy_sprite_values_four_fields
description: Copies four 32-bit values from a table record into shared locations, then copies a shared sprite value and returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A606
name: update_active_record_tables
description: Scans an 86-byte object table and a 24-word table, calling a helper for each entry whose flag bit is set or whose pointer is nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A870
name: tick_timed_effect_countdown
description: Decrements a countdown; while it stays nonzero it calls a helper and restores saved shared words, and at zero it marks a per-object flag, calls the next helper and copies a stored value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A878
name: tick_countdown_and_set_color
description: Decrements the countdown; while it stays nonzero it calls a helper and restores saved shared words, and at zero it writes a value to the background color register, calls the next helper and copies a stored value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A912
name: check_offsets_within_range
description: Selects one of two stored pointers by a flag, computes offsets between the current position and a stored reference position, and calls a helper when any offset falls outside a plus-or-minus 16384 range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:A94A
name: evaluate_proximity_conditions
description: Tests range and proximity conditions on stored positions and a flag, calls helper routines when they hold, and records a result flag in a shared word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:AB20
name: reset_shared_state_variables
description: Zeroes a block of shared position, angle and status variables, sets two four-character digit strings to zero and sets a counter to 10000, then calls helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:AC72
name: process_control_state_messages
description: Derives scaled values from two input words, then calls seventeen helper routines, including the ones that show the brakes-on and landing-gear-raised messages.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:BDCE
name: update_two_bit_mode_timer
description: Reads a two-bit mode field from a byte in the object record and, when it changes, stores the new value and resets a 127-count timer, then calls helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:BEBE
name: store_previous_position_and_angle
description: Saves the three current position words as previous values, reads a new angle from a helper, unwraps it by a full turn when the change exceeds 8192, and looks up a sample from a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:BEC2
name: update_angle_and_table_sample
description: Reads a new angle from a helper, unwraps it by a full turn when the change exceeds 8192, and looks up a sample from a table, calling further helpers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_table_samples_by_fraction
description: Interpolates three pairs of table values using the low five bits of the coordinates as the fraction, producing blended values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1B8
name: blend_two_table_samples
description: Blends values from two tables at two coordinate positions using fractional bits and stores the blended results.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1CC
name: blend_table_samples_for_coords
description: Blends values from two tables at two coordinate positions using fractional bits, returning the results in shared locations.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1E0
name: interpolate_coordinate_table_pair
description: Interpolates table values at two coordinate positions using the low five bits of each coordinate as the fraction, storing the blended results.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1E8
name: interpolate_coordinate_table_triple
description: Interpolates three table value pairs at two coordinate positions using their fractional bits, storing the blended results.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1EC
name: interpolate_coordinate_table_sample
description: Interpolates table values at two coordinate positions using their fractional bits and stores the blended result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C1F0
name: interpolate_and_mask_table_values
description: Interpolates table values at two coordinate positions using their fractional bits, merges a constant mask into the result and calls helper routines to store the blended values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C3CE
name: transform_coordinates_by_matrix
description: Multiplies coordinate pairs by a scale value and a set of stored coefficients, rounds the sums to 16-bit results and stores them in shared locations.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C512
name: transform_coordinates_second_matrix
description: Multiplies coordinate pairs by a scale value and a second set of stored coefficients, rounds the sums to 16-bit results and stores them in shared locations.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C656
name: transform_coordinates_third_matrix
description: Multiplies coordinate pairs by stored coefficients and a scale value, rounds the sums to 16-bit results and stores them, using a constant mask and helper calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C79A
name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Runs a seven-step restoring loop over a 32-bit value starting from 16384 and returns a 16-bit result, the pattern of an integer square root.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C7C4
name: normalize_fixed_point_value
description: When the count is zero it returns the high word only; otherwise it takes the absolute value of the low word, records its sign and shifts it by the count to produce a normalised fixed-point result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C820
name: subtract_from_quarter_turn
description: Calls a helper routine and returns 16384, a quarter of the 16-bit range, minus its 16-bit result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C82C
name: find_table_index_by_magnitude
description: Takes the absolute value of a 16-bit input, starts from a table entry chosen by its high bits and advances while the table values are at most the input, then restores the sign of the index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:C862
name: update_landing_and_rearm_status
description: Updates a status word from flag bits in an object record and speed and position values, calls seven helpers, and shows the ready-for-takeoff, safe-landing or weapons-replenished messages.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:D0CE
name: set_flag_bits_and_angle
description: Sets three flag bits in a record, calls seven helpers, then multiplies a stored position by 360 and takes the high word to produce a scaled angle index and offset for the display routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:D0F2
name: update_weapon_status_display
description: Waits on the blitter busy flag and programs blitter registers when a toggle is set, then calls seventeen helper routines that show the missile-lock, primary, no-target and secondary weapon messages.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:D82A
name: start_blitter_single_plane_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its pointer, control and size registers for a single-plane operation, and starts it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:DA0E
name: set_bit_and_alternate_blit
description: Sets a bit in a memory word addressed by an index, adds 32768 to an accumulator and starts a blit only when the previous accumulator value was below 32768, so it runs on alternate calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:DA2C
name: draw_alternating_blit_frame
description: Alternates between two blitter passes on successive calls using an accumulator, waits for the blitter and programs its registers, then calls sixteen helper routines for drawing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:DEF2
name: copy_clipped_sprite_rows
description: When the coordinates lie inside a fixed window, computes a bitplane offset and copies six groups of five words from the source block into the bitplane, then calls a helper.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:DFB0
name: project_screen_offset
description: Projects the offsets between a position and a reference point by scaling each axis with a shift and a table value, subtracts the two results and adds the constant 146 to give a screen coordinate.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E00C
name: start_blitter_copy_block
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its pointer, control and size registers for a copy, starts it and returns the input byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E068
name: start_blitter_plain_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its pointer, control and size registers with a fixed control value, starts the blit and returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E0A6
name: compute_max_axis_distance
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical differences from a reference point, derives an offset into a table, and keeps the larger difference as the distance measure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E0AA
name: compute_offset_axis_distance
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical differences from a reference point after adding a fixed offset, derives a table index, and keeps the larger difference as the distance.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E0AE
name: compute_shifted_axis_distance
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical differences from a reference point using a shifted coordinate, derives a table index, and keeps the larger difference as the distance.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E0B2
name: compute_indexed_axis_distance
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical differences from a reference point using a table-derived index, and keeps the larger difference as the distance measure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E0BC
name: compute_scaled_axis_distance
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical differences from a scaled reference point, derives a table offset and stores the larger difference in the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E16A
name: process_active_table_entries
description: Waits for the blitter, then loops over 24-word table entries and calls helper routines for each entry whose flag bit is set and whose field is nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E21E
name: start_blitter_combined_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its pointer, mask, control and size registers with fixed values, and starts the copy.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E276
name: start_blitter_swapped_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs the pointer registers with the two plane addresses in swapped order, sets control and size values, and starts the blit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E3CE
name: compute_bitplane_row_address
description: Converts a position difference into shifted screen coordinates offset by 79 and 154, derives a row from a helper call, and computes a bitplane address using 160-byte rows, returning early when a flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E3D2
name: compute_scaled_bitplane_offset
description: Computes two shifted coordinate differences offset by 79 and 154, derives a bitplane offset from a helper result and a 160-byte row stride, and returns early when a flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E3D6
name: compute_clipped_bitplane_offset
description: Computes two shifted coordinate differences offset by 79 and 154, derives a bitplane offset using a 160-byte row stride, and clips the result before storing it when a flag is clear.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E3DA
name: compute_bitplane_offset_and_draw
description: Computes shifted coordinate differences and a bitplane offset using a 160-byte row stride, then calls helper routines to draw at that offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E432
name: copy_position_state_and_update
description: Copies a block of shared position and coordinate values into their working locations, updates a table offset, and calls seven helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E852
name: walk_linked_object_list
description: Looks up a record through a pointer table indexed by a seven-bit value, returns early when its fields are nonzero, and otherwise walks a chain of linked records calling helper routines for each.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E9BE
name: update_scaled_positions_and_entries
description: Stores two position values shifted right by five as coordinates, calls a helper for each 50-byte table entry whose flag bits are clear, then calls a final helper.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E9C2
name: store_scaled_positions_and_entries
description: Stores two position values shifted right by five as coordinates, calls a helper for each 50-byte table entry whose flag bits are clear, then calls a final helper.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:E9DE
name: process_flagged_entry_table
description: Loops over 50-byte table entries, calling helper routines for each entry whose flag bits are clear, then calls two final helpers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EA26
name: start_blitter_offset_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its pointer, mask, control and size registers with offset-based source and destination addresses, then starts the blit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EA7E
name: call_handler_if_in_window
description: Computes two scaled offsets and, when both lie inside a fixed window, calls a handler from the global table indexed by a value; otherwise it returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EB6E
name: and_mask_eight_plane_words
description: ANDs a mask value into eight words spaced 20 bytes apart in the bitplane buffer, clearing the masked bits in each.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EB8E
name: mix_or_and_plane_words
description: ORs one value into four of eight words spaced 20 bytes apart and ANDs another value into the remaining four, setting and clearing bits in the bitplane.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EBAE
name: mix_complement_plane_words
description: ANDs and ORs a pair of values into eight words spaced 20 bytes apart, using the complementary row layout of its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EBCE
name: mix_or_and_plane_pattern
description: ORs a value into five of eight words spaced 20 bytes apart and ANDs another into the remaining three, writing a fixed bitplane pattern.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EBEE
name: or_mask_eight_plane_words
description: ORs a mask value into eight words spaced 20 bytes apart in the bitplane buffer, setting the masked bits in each.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:EC0E
name: update_plane_rows_by_scale
description: Clamps a stored value to 40, and when it changes, ORs or clears bit patterns in the bitplane rows of three planes using the difference, then calls helper routines; the 9999 text is referenced.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:F822
name: copy_table_shape_into_planes
description: Uses an index to pick a horizontal offset from a table, then copies shape words from a table into three bitplane positions, sets flags and calls helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:FAC2
name: start_blitter_masked_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its pointer, modulo, control and size registers for a masked copy with a 34-byte modulo, and starts it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:FBDE
name: spread_bytes_into_three_planes
description: Expands a block of bytes into three bitplane rows at a 160-byte stride, spreading each byte's bits into place at shifts of zero, four and eight.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:FD8C
name: shift_plane_words_right_one
description: Shifts 16-bit plane words one bit right across rows of seven words, carrying the lowest bit of each row into the top bit of the next, and writes the result to a destination.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:FDCC
name: pack_nibbles_from_lookup
description: Repeatedly packs four table-looked-up bytes, each shifted into a different nibble position, into one 16-bit word per row until a zero row terminator, writing the packed words to a destination.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:FE3E
name: set_palette_colour_values
description: Writes nine 12-bit colour values to the colour registers for palette entries 17 to 31.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:FE88
name: or_rotated_sector_masks
description: Scales an angle to a 0-to-360 value, derives a sector index and offset, then ORs rotated mask sets into bitplane rows at several positions, calling five helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:10B62
name: scale_step_with_clamp
description: Scales a stored value by 32 with a sign-dependent direction, computes a clamped step offset, and calls four helper routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:10DBA
